title: CounterFactual Retrieval for Evidence-Aware Individual Animal Identification
abstract: arXiv:2611.06864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated identification of individual animals is moving from small curated studies toward shared benchmarks and reusable foundation models. This progress is useful, but current evaluation leaves the evidence behind a match unresolved, i.e., high retrieval accuracy does not show whether a model used animal features or identity-correlated shortcuts. We address this with Counterfactual Foreground Retrieval (CFR), an evidence-aware evaluation protocol. CFR evaluates the same query-gallery task under different views: full image, foreground-only, and shortcut-only. The full-image measures standard retrieval performance; the foreground-only measures foreground-supported retrieval; and shortcut-only view measure how much identity signal is recoverable from background, or silhouette. translated_title: 面向证据感知的个体动物识别的反事实检索方法
translated_abstract: 自动化的个体动物识别正在从小规模精选研究向共享基准和可复用的基础模型发展。这一进步是有价值的，但当前的评估方式未能揭示匹配结果背后的证据依据，即高检索准确率无法表明模型究竟是使用了动物本身的特征，还是利用了与身份相关的捷径信息。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了反事实前景检索（CounterFactual Foreground Retrieval, CFR），这是一种证据感知的评估协议。CFR 在不同视图下评估同一查询-图库检索任务：完整图像视图衡量标准检索性能；仅前景视图衡量由前景支撑的检索能力；仅捷径视图则衡量从背景或轮廓中可恢复的身份信号量。由此，单一的检索分数被转化为一份证据画像：包括模型在原始图像上的表现，以及当仅有动物（前景）信息时该性能能保留多少。
tldr: 提出反事实前景检索（CFR）这一证据感知评估协议，通过完整图像、仅前景、仅捷径三种视图对动物个体识别进行评测，将检索分数转化为证据画像，从而揭示模型是依赖动物特征还是身份相关的背景捷径。
en_tdlr: Proposes Counterfactual Forensic Retrieval (CFR), an evidence-aware evaluation protocol that assesses animal re-identification across full-image, foreground-only, and shortcut-only views, turning retrieval scores into evidence profiles that reveal whether models rely on genuine animal features or identity-correlated background shortcuts.
